en:
Integration Challenges (ICs) are the fourth type of Challenges. Integration Challenges take place in Integrations, and
each Integration Challenge works uniquely compared to the rest. Most ICs require i to be completed, but some require y2.
Integration Challenges are unlocked through the Production Tree in the "Integration Upgrades" subtab. You need to
fulfill a requirement or set of requirements to unlock the Integration Challenge. Once unlocked, you do not need to
unlock it again. Once you've completed all eight Integration Challenges, you will win the game.
zh:
积分挑战（ICs）是第四种挑战。积分挑战发生在积分层中，并且
每个积分挑战的运作方式都与其他挑战不同。多数 ICs 需要完成 i，但有些需要 y2。
积分挑战通过“积分升级”子标签页中的产出树解锁。你需要
满足一项或多项要求来解锁积分挑战。一旦解锁，你就不需要
再次解锁它。完成全部八个积分挑战后，你将赢得游戏。
积分挑战（v3.0 第 2 部分）
积分升级（v3.0 第 1 部分）

en: It's difficult to trace the origins of the incremental game genre, but here is a notable person in the genre's history: John Incremental was a medieval European game developer who created the first incremental game in 1316, drawing crowds from all over.
